$comment: How ShinyQ HQ itself was built (owner request 2026-10-15). Knowledge for the Ask the HQ chatbot only: this file is not rendered; the long form is the /build page (content/build-story.json). It becomes one knowledge chunk (`site-build`) that is always retrieved for questions about this site (`isSiteQuestion` in functions/_lib/scope.ts), and an answer to such a question cites the /build page (`SITE_BUILD_PAGE` in src/ask/pack.ts), which links `source`, the public repository. Facts only, third person, verified against the repository; never a client company (C3), a cloud resource name, a hostname or a number that is not in the repository. It covers the stack, hosting, the assistant, the test gates, the visitor controls, per-page URLs and ?view=classic, and the secret B1 Engine Room. Update it in the same PR when the stack, hosting, the assistant, the test gates or the visitor controls (Rover, floors, minimap, settings, links) change. Validated by SiteBuildSchema (src/content/schema.ts) and the public-safety lint.

text.en: Kurniadi built ShinyQ HQ from October 2026 through reviewed pull requests. AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot and Claude Code) implemented written design specs and feature plans; he owned review and merge decisions. The stack is a Next.js 16 static export, React 19, strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl for English and Indonesian, and zod-validated content. The tower uses three.js through React Three Fiber and zustand, with full, lite or static device tiers. Motion reduces animation; the Classic site presents the same content as accessible HTML without WebGL. Hosting is Cloudflare Pages, with Pages Functions for the assistant, performance beacons and visit stats, plus KV, Analytics Engine and the hq-stats Cron Worker. Rover is a small robot guide in the 3D tower. Ask AI opens a separate chat panel, Ask Rover Assistant (internally Ask the HQ). It retrieves a curated pack of public site content, using Gemma 4 on Workers AI through AI Gateway, then Mistral Small 3.1 and Groq as fallbacks, with Turnstile, rate limits and output checks. Vitest, Playwright shards, Lighthouse CI and 3D gates check draw calls, triangles, JavaScript size and memory. Production deploys through a workflow after merge: it reuses green PR checks for the same tree or waits for full main CI; red main CI triggers rollback. Source: ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ on GitHub. Drive Rover with WASD, arrow keys or the touch joystick. Hold Shift to boost to about twice the speed, or double-tap the joystick to toggle boost. Point-and-go drives to and opens glowing rooms, pads or boards: click on desktop, tap twice on touch screens. The elevator serves L1 Lobby, L2 Career Road, L3 Project Roads, L4 Writing and the RF roof deck. A first-visit tutorial and hints explain the controls; Settings replays the tutorial or toggles hints. The Rover menu offers room shortcuts. Tap the round minimap or press N for a floor overview and destination selection. Settings also controls language, motion, graphics, day/night, minimap, sound and music. Pages have shareable URLs; in 3D, a project or floor link navigates there. ?view=classic explicitly selects the Classic site; an ordinary link can follow the recipient's remembered view preference. Visiting all five public floors unlocks B1 Engine Room in the elevator. Its five active stations and two coming-soon bays complement the public /build page, which covers architecture, build rounds, the AI-agent workflow, quality gates and figures.
text.id: Kurniadi membangun ShinyQ HQ sejak Oktober 2026 melalui pull request yang di-review. AI coding agent (GitHub Copilot dan Claude Code) mengimplementasikan spec dan rencana fitur; Kurniadi memegang keputusan review dan merge. Stack: static export Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl untuk bahasa Inggris dan Indonesia, serta konten yang divalidasi zod. Menara memakai three.js melalui React Three Fiber dan zustand, dengan tier full, lite, atau static sesuai perangkat. Motion mengurangi animasi; Situs klasik menyajikan konten yang sama sebagai HTML aksesibel tanpa WebGL. Hosting memakai Cloudflare Pages, Pages Functions untuk asisten, beacon performa dan statistik kunjungan, serta KV, Analytics Engine dan Cron Worker hq-stats. Rover adalah robot pemandu kecil di menara 3D. Tanya AI membuka panel chat terpisah, Asisten Rover (secara internal Ask the HQ). Konteksnya diambil dari pack terkurasi konten publik situs. Modelnya Gemma 4 di Workers AI melalui AI Gateway, dengan fallback Mistral Small 3.1 lalu Groq, dilindungi Turnstile, rate limit dan output check. Pengujian memakai Vitest, shard Playwright, Lighthouse CI, serta gate 3D untuk draw call, segitiga, ukuran JavaScript dan memori. Deploy production melalui workflow setelah merge: memakai ulang CI PR yang hijau untuk tree yang sama atau menunggu seluruh CI main; CI main yang merah memicu rollback. Kode sumber: ShinyQ/ShinyQ-HQ di GitHub. Kemudikan Rover dengan WASD, tombol panah, atau joystick layar sentuh. Tahan Shift untuk mempercepat hingga sekitar dua kali lipat; ketuk dua kali joystick untuk menyalakan atau mematikan percepatan ini. Point-and-go mengantar Rover ke ruangan, pad, atau papan menyala lalu membukanya: klik di desktop, ketuk dua kali di layar sentuh. Lift melayani L1 Lobby, L2 Career Road, L3 Project Roads, L4 Writing, dan dek atap RF. Tutorial kunjungan pertama dan petunjuk menjelaskan kontrol; Pengaturan bisa mengulang tutorial atau menyalakan dan mematikan petunjuk. Menu Rover berisi pintasan ruangan. Ketuk minimap bundar atau tekan N untuk melihat lantai dan memilih tujuan. Pengaturan juga mencakup bahasa, motion, grafis, siang/malam, minimap, suara dan musik. Setiap halaman punya URL yang bisa dibagikan; dalam 3D, tautan proyek atau lantai mengantar Rover ke sana. ?view=classic memilih Situs klasik secara eksplisit; tautan biasa bisa mengikuti pilihan tampilan yang tersimpan di perangkat penerima. Mengunjungi kelima lantai publik membuka Ruang Mesin B1 di lift. Lima stasiun aktif dan dua bay coming soon melengkapi halaman publik /build tentang arsitektur, putaran pembangunan, alur kerja AI agent, quality gate dan angka-angkanya.
